selection: Same two earlier Tier 1 folds; no Brier regression in either, at least 0.0005 mean improvement, no aggregate accuracy regression; choose lowest mean Brier
promotion: No automatic promotion; require separately collected future maps and confirmation that series identity is available at live publication time

guardrails: Exact league, series and team IDs required; never infer a series by team names or future maps
Unknown series identity falls back to zero context
Only maps completed more than 60 seconds before the next map may enter context
No knowledge of eventual series length or winner
48-hour maximum earlier-map age and no more than four previous maps
All 442 final maps remain in the comparison
The live model is never replaced by this script
